title: Xanthe and the Songbook
author: Marguerite Ashgrove
blurb: Astrid Underhill, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
